description: Department of Census & Statistics - The National Consumer Price Index - March, 2019
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for March 2019, as computed by the Department of Census and Statistics. The content is purely statistical and informational, relating to economic data publication. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any of the specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters). Therefore, it falls under Miscellaneous administrative matters.
